notes: the folder-trust dialog as Claude Code 2.1.261 actually renders it: UNNUMBERED (no "N." prefixes) with the default highlight on the DESTRUCTIVE choice, "❯ No, exit", and "Yes, I trust this folder" one row below it. Accepting therefore means \x1b[B\r, never a digit. Captured under tmux by driving a real claude binary at a fresh directory and dumping the pane's raw output — NOT via `screenbench-record`, whose harness answers the dialog before a recording starts. Replay incrementally in chunks of ~128 bytes: a whole-file write snapshots only the last frame, and chunks small enough to split a row mid-paint make the adapter see a truncated option label and fire a second InputRequested.
